audit:internal-pages.summary: The eight internal pages are thin wrappers around one shared component, components/PageShell.tsx (16 lines): a dark hero band with the same violet top-right glow, one content block, and the footer. /create, /build and /grow are 4-line files rendering the same StudioPage.tsx (22 lines), differing only in the bullet/eyebrow accent colour and data. Measured across 360/390/768/1440: every page has 0 running animations, 0 img/video/canvas/svg in main, and 70-197 words. Content is honest and all links work, but two H1s are clipped on phones and none of the pages is portfolio-grade or has a division identity.
keep: Service catalogue is accurate and complete against the spec: V1-V5, T1-T5, M1-M3 all render from data/site.ts (single source of truth), with no invented prices, timelines, revision counts, clients or statistics on any internal page.

GROW Beta labelling on /grow: eyebrow 'GROW · BETA', the lilac disclaimer box ('Nothing here is a guarantee of leads, sales or return on ad spend'), and the CTA wording 'Join the beta list' (components/StudioPage.tsx:8-9,19). Keep the wording; restyle only.

Studio CTAs work and pre-select the form: clicking the CTA on /create, /build, /grow lands on /contact?service=<id> with the select set to 'CREATE — Video editing', 'BUILD — Website development', 'GROW — Digital marketing (beta interest)' respectively (verified by puppeteer).
About copy is honest and on-spec: 'small team of video editors, web developers and client managers', no names, no headcount, no incorporation/trademark claims, no awards (app/about/page.tsx:12).

FAQ answers cover all six spec topics without inventing guarantees ('We don't promise timelines we haven't scoped'); light editorial FAQ body with hairline dividers reads calm and clean at 1440 and 390.
Privacy/Terms are openly labelled 'Draft placeholder. Requires owner and legal review before launch.' — no invented policy text.
Syne is the only computed font family on all 8 pages at all 4 widths.

Keyboard basics: skip link is first tab stop, every link shows a 2px solid cyan focus outline, whole studio card on /studios is a single focusable link; mobile menu button is 44x44 with aria-expanded.
Per-page <title> template ('CREATE — MAKENDLESS' etc.) and the footer link set matching the spec (CREATE, BUILD, GROW — Beta, Studios, About, FAQ, Contact, Privacy, Terms).
Typed data model in data/site.ts (studios, packages, solutions, process, faqs) — richer pages should be built on it rather than replacing it.

findings.title: /build H1 'Website Development' is clipped off-screen on phones
findings.where: components/PageShell.tsx:8 (h1 text-4xl, no wrap/clamp); http://localhost:3456/build at 360 and 390
findings.evidence: Measured h1 scrollWidth 391px vs clientWidth 350px at 390 (320px at 360); documentElement scrollWidth 411 vs clientWidth 390/360. body has overflow-x:hidden (globals.css:22) so the word is simply cut: docs/audit/390-page-build.png shows 'Development' with the final 't' chopped at the right edge.
findings.fix: Use a fluid heading size in PageShell (e.g. text-[clamp(1.75rem,8.5vw,3.75rem)]) plus overflow-wrap/hyphens or text-balance, and verify the longest single word ('Development', 'possibilities.') fits at 360. Do not rely on body overflow-x:hidden to mask overflow.

findings.title: /studios H1 'possibilities.' overflows at 360px
findings.evidence: h1 scrollWidth 342 vs clientWidth 320; document scrollWidth 362 vs 360. Screenshot docs/audit/tmp/internal-360-studios.png shows the full stop of 'possibilities.' touching/cut by the right edge. Fits at 390 (350/350) with zero spare room.
findings.fix: Same fluid H1 clamp as above; test at 360.

findings.title: CREATE, BUILD and GROW pages are one identical template — no division visual or motion identity
findings.where: components/StudioPage.tsx:1-22; app/create|build|grow/page.tsx (4 lines each); docs/audit/1440-page-create.png vs 1440-page-grow.png
findings.evidence: The three pages share the same hero band, same #202342 rounded-3xl cards in a 2-col grid, same white pill CTA. The only per-division difference is the 6px bullet and code-label colour (s.accent). Measured on all three at every width: document.getAnimations().length = 0, media elements in main = 0. Spec: 'Each division has its own visual and motion identity' and 'Portfolio-grade ... not a template'.
findings.fix: Keep StudioPage's data plumbing but give each division its own hero and section treatment using CSS/SVG/video motion (no R3F — spec restricts 3D to homepage sections): CREATE = timeline/playhead, vertical reel frames, caption-pop kinetic type in aqua; BUILD = wireframe-to-UI grid, browser chrome, responsive resize motif in violet; GROW = clearly 'Illustrative demo' ad-card/calendar motif in lilac with no numbers. Reuse the homepage Studios/Transformation preview pieces.

findings.title: Studio pages are content-thin: three bullets per service, nothing else
findings.evidence: Main word counts (incl. nav/footer text): /create 129, /build 119, /grow 114. No packages (data/site.ts:68-85 has 4 CREATE, 5 BUILD, 1 GROW package that are never shown here), no process steps, no who-it's-for, no concept demo, no FAQ, no cross-link to other studios, a single CTA at the very bottom. 5 cards in a 2-col grid leave an orphan card and an empty half-row at 1440 (1440-page-create.png, 1440-page-grow.png).
findings.fix: Build each studio page from existing data: service catalogue (fix the orphan with a 3+2 / featured-first layout), the division's packages with 'Request Quote' links (/contact?service=<id>-<package>), relevant customer types from solutions, the 4-step process, a 'Concept demo' visual, 2-3 relevant FAQs, and next/previous studio links. Add a CTA in the hero as well as at the end.

findings.title: All eight pages are the same dark shell with the same violet corner glow
findings.evidence: Section backgrounds measured: /studios, /create, /build, /grow, /about = rgb(12,16,36) hero + rgb(12,16,36) body + dark footer (three consecutive identical dark blocks, no boundary). Only /faq, /privacy, /terms pass light. Hero uses one hard-coded radial-gradient(… rgba(111,69,246,.35)) for every page, and the eyebrow is always #08bbd4 — so the BUILD and GROW eyebrows are aqua (CREATE's colour) instead of violet/lilac (see 1440-page-grow.png 'GROW · BETA' in aqua). Spec: dark and light sections must alternate; avoid a uniformly dark site and repetitive glows.
findings.fix: Give PageShell an accent prop (eyebrow + glow colour per division) and hero variants; alternate dark hero / light editorial body / dark CTA on the studio, studios and about pages; replace the repeated corner glow with division-specific art.

findings.title: /studios overview is three small text cards — weaker than the homepage studios section it is linked from
findings.evidence: Page body is 394px tall at 1440 (total page 1173px incl. footer), 82 words, three ~200px cards with verb, name, one-line tagline; no service list, no previews, no arrow/affordance, no CTA. The homepage 'Explore Services' button (components/Solutions.tsx:43) sends users here, but no services are listed. Hover is the only feedback (translate/border).
findings.fix: Make this a real overview: large gateway per studio with its service codes/titles (V1-V5, T1-T5, M1-M3), a preview visual, explicit 'Explore CREATE →' affordance, GROW Beta chip, and a closing Start a Project CTA. Reuse the homepage Studios gateway component at larger scale rather than a second, lesser card design.

findings.title: About page is a three-card stub with no CTA or links
findings.evidence: Body is 446px tall at 1440; three cards that repeat the studio taglines plus one paragraph. main contains zero links (mainLinks = []) — the cards are not linked to /create /build /grow and there is no Start a Project CTA. The Grow card has no Beta chip (beta is only mentioned in body text).
findings.fix: Expand with honest, non-invented content: how the studio works (process from data), principles (scope in writing, honest about beta, human review), who it serves, link each card to its studio page, add a Beta chip on Grow, end with a Start a Project CTA. No names, headcount or history unless the owner supplies them.

findings.title: About page states an AI-usage policy the spec does not supply
findings.evidence: Copy: 'we use AI tools to move faster while people review every final result.' Nothing in docs/SPEC-WORKING.md states this practice; it reads as a process commitment ('every final result'). It is not an AI service offering, so it does not breach the no-AI-service rule, but it is an unverified claim.
findings.fix: Get owner confirmation or remove the sentence; list it in TODO-FOR-OWNER.md.

findings.title: No motion at all on any internal page
findings.evidence: document.getAnimations().length = 0 on all 8 pages at all widths (and therefore no distinct reduced-motion variant either). Only interaction is a hover translate on /studios cards. Spec quality bar: 'Varied professional motion: kinetic typography, mask reveals, scroll-driven transitions'.
findings.fix: Add a mask/line reveal on the page H1, staggered reveal for service rows, and one division-specific looping CSS/SVG motif per studio page; gate all of it behind prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.title: FAQ page is a static copy of the six homepage FAQs with no next step
findings.evidence: Same six items as data/site.ts:109-116 used on the homepage; no grouping, no links in main (mainLinks = []), the answer 'Use Start a Project…' is not a link, and the page ends without a CTA. Answer lines run the full 1024px measure (~150 characters per line at 1440).
findings.fix: Cap answers at ~65ch, link 'Start a Project' inline, add a 'Still have a question?' CTA band, and consider grouping (Getting started / Quotes & revisions / Delivery & support). Any extra questions need owner-approved answers.

findings.title: Legal placeholders are honest but would ship as-is, and Terms copy is grammatically off
findings.evidence: Both pages show one sentence in a 240px body. Terms reads 'has not yet approved formal Terms policy text' (templated string). No TODO-FOR-OWNER.md exists in the repo (find returned nothing) although the spec says missing items go there. Placeholder pages have no noindex.
findings.fix: Keep the honesty; fix wording ('formal Terms of Service text'), add robots noindex metadata to both until approved, add a link back to Contact, and create TODO-FOR-OWNER.md listing privacy/terms text.

findings.title: Footer links are 19px tall — below the 44px touch-target rule
findings.where: components/FinalCta.tsx:16 (footer shown on every internal page); 360/390 widths
findings.evidence: Measured at 360 and 390: CREATE 58x19, BUILD 46x19, GROW — Beta 102x19, All studios 71x19, About 43x19, FAQ 30x19, Contact 58x19, Privacy 52x19, Terms 43x19, spaced by space-y-3 (12px). Header wordmark link is 246x28. Spec: touch targets >= 44px.
findings.fix: Make footer links block/inline-flex with min-h-11 and vertical padding (py-3) and drop the space-y; give the wordmark link min-h-11.

findings.title: No current-page indication in navigation
findings.evidence: document.querySelectorAll('[aria-current]').length = 0 on every page; nav links are all the same muted colour regardless of route (see 1440-page-about.png — 'About' not highlighted). CREATE/BUILD/GROW pages also have no breadcrumb or back link to /studios.
findings.fix: Use usePathname to set aria-current='page' and an active style; add a 'Studios /' breadcrumb or sibling-studio switcher on division pages.

findings.title: Heading semantics: footer column labels are H2s; FAQ questions are not headings
findings.evidence: Heading outline on /faq is H1 then H2 'Studios', H2 'Company', H2 'Legal' only — the six questions are dt elements, so the only H2s on the page are footer labels. Same footer H2s appear at the same level as service titles on studio pages.
findings.fix: Render footer labels as non-heading text (the nav already has aria-label) or H3; keep the dl but that is acceptable, or use h2 per question.

findings.title: Every internal page shares the homepage meta description; no OG tags, favicon, robots or sitemap; default unstyled 404
findings.where: app/layout.tsx:8-11; app/*/page.tsx metadata; app/ (no not-found.tsx, icon, robots.ts, sitemap.ts); public/ is empty
findings.evidence: meta description identical on all 8 pages; og:title absent; canonical absent; /favicon.ico 404 (console error logged on first load), /robots.txt 404, /sitemap.xml 404. /nope renders Next's default '404 — This page could not be found.' under the nav with no footer or link home (docs/audit/tmp/internal-1440-404.png).
findings.fix: Add per-page description + openGraph in each metadata export, app/icon, robots.ts, sitemap.ts, and a branded app/not-found.tsx using PageShell with links to Home/Studios/Contact.

findings.title: Hero band leaves large dead space and inconsistent heights
findings.evidence: At 1440 there is ~160px of empty dark between the intro line and the first card on studio pages (1440-page-create.png: intro at y≈285, cards at y≈460) with no divider, since hero and body are the same colour. Hero heights vary 363-438px purely by H1 wrapping.
findings.fix: Tighten spacing or fill the hero with division art on the right; make the hero-to-body transition intentional (colour change, rule, or overlap).

ownerTodos: Approve or supply real Privacy Policy and Terms text (currently honest placeholders); no TODO-FOR-OWNER.md file exists in the repo yet — it needs creating.
Confirm or remove the About-page sentence 'we use AI tools to move faster while people review every final result' (app/about/page.tsx:12) — not in the spec.
Supply any About-page facts wanted beyond the generic description (origin, location, working hours, how the team collaborates) — nothing can be invented.

Decide whether GROW's 'Join the beta list' should remain a contact-form inquiry (currently pre-selects 'GROW — Digital marketing (beta interest)') — the form has no delivery channel yet (NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL unset).
Provide or approve original concept-demo footage/imagery for the CREATE and BUILD pages if real media is wanted instead of CSS/SVG concept demos.
Approve any additional FAQ questions/answers per division (revision limits, timelines and support terms must come from the owner).
Supply favicon / social-share image artwork.

audit:studios.summary: Section 2 (components/Studios.tsx, 73 lines, server component) is a dark #0c1024 block with an eyebrow, the correct headline "Three worlds. Endless possibilities." and three whole-card links to /create, /build, /grow. Each card is the same rounded #202342 tile with a small 320x200 looping SVG pictogram, verb label, name, one-line tagline and "Enter studio →"; the middle card is lifted 32px. Links, hover lift, keyboard focus ring, Syne-only type and no horizontal overflow (360/390/768/1024/1440) all work. But the BUILD preview renders as an empty dashed box at every width (code bug), the GROW Beta badge is clipped out of view at 768-~900px, the SMIL motion ignores reduced-motion, and the section is the same dark ink as both the hero above and Live Transformation below. Verdict: these are generic template cards with small SVG icons, not premium gateways with service previews and distinct motion identities.
keep: Headline copy exactly on spec: 'Three worlds. Endless possibilities.' with prism gradient on the second sentence; strong Syne display type at 1440 (60px).

Whole card is a single <Link> (not a small button): tap targets are large (350x423-455px at 390, 320x404-436px at 360) and all three navigate correctly to /create, /build, /grow (verified by click: h1 'Video Editing', 'Website Development', 'Digital Marketing').
Semantic structure: section[aria-labelledby=studios-title] > ul > li > a, aria-label on GROW includes '(Beta)' ('GROW: Digital Marketing (Beta)'), SVGs are aria-hidden.

Keyboard focus: Tab order create -> build -> grow, visible 2px cyan outline with 3px offset on each card (docs/audit/tmp/studios-focus-build.png), plus focus-visible lift mirrors hover, so nothing is hover-only.
Division accent colours match the spec (CREATE #22d3ee, BUILD #8b5cf6, GROW #c7a6ff) and data comes from data/site.ts single source of truth.
No horizontal overflow at 360/390/768/1024/1440 (scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0 at all five); only Syne is used in the section.
Mobile (360/390): the three cards stack full-width in a clear order and are easy to find and tap; BETA badge is visible there.

Staggered desktop composition (middle card raised) is a good starting idea for a non-grid layout; GROW's honest tagline 'We are learning in public. Join the beta list.' and the 'ILLUSTRATIVE' label on the bar chart are the right honesty instinct.

findings.title: BUILD gateway preview is an empty dashed box (layout blocks never render)
findings.where: components/Studios.tsx:24-25; selector #studios a[href="/build"] svg rect; all widths
findings.evidence: The block array uses keys {x,y,w,h} and is spread with {...b}, so the rects get attributes 'x,y,w,h,rx,fill,opacity' - no width/height. Measured in DOM at 768/800/900/1024/1440: all four animated rects have getBBox() width 0, height 0. Visible in docs/audit/1440-home-02-studios.png, 390-home-02-studios.png and every frame of docs/audit/tmp/studios-phase-0..3.png: BUILD shows only a dashed outline on a blank panel while CREATE and GROW have content. The flagship website-development gateway looks unfinished.
findings.fix: Map to real SVG attributes: <rect x={b.x} y={b.y} width={b.w} height={b.h} .../>. Better: replace with a proper wireframe-to-finished mini browser preview (see the visual-weak finding).

findings.title: GROW Beta badge is clipped out of sight at tablet widths (768 to ~900px)
findings.where: components/Studios.tsx:53 (overflow-hidden), :57-62 (flex row with h3 + badge); http://localhost:3456/#studios at 768, 800, 900
findings.evidence: At 768 the badge's left edge is x=745 while the card's right edge is x=736, so it is 100% outside the overflow-hidden card: docs/audit/tmp/studios-768-cards.png and studios-768-full.png show the GROW card with no Beta indicator at all. At 800: badge 766-822 vs card right 768 (invisible). At 900: badge 833-889 vs card right 868 (cut in half). At 1024 it still overhangs the padding (badge right 972 vs inner right 967). Spec: 'GROW labelled Beta / Coming Soon everywhere' and 768 is a required check width.
findings.fix: Do not put the badge in a non-wrapping flex row beside the h3. Place the BETA pill on the verb line (GROW · BETA) or absolutely in the preview corner, add min-w-0 to the text column and shrink-0 to the badge, and consider 'Beta - coming soon' wording. Re-test at 768/820/900/1024.

findings.title: Studio names overflow and are cut off at 768 ('Website Developm')
findings.evidence: At 768 cards are only 221px wide with 24px Syne Extrabold: BUILD h3 text right edge = 559px vs card right edge 495px (64px clipped; screenshot docs/audit/tmp/studios-768-cards.png reads 'Website Developm'). 'Digital Marketing' ends at 733 vs card inner edge 711 (touches the card border). Still overflowing at 900 (603 vs inner 558) and marginally at 1024 (644 vs 640).
findings.fix: Recompose for tablet: keep a single column or a 1-large + 2-stacked layout until lg (>=1024), or use fluid type (clamp ~1.1rem-1.5rem) plus min-w-0 / overflow-wrap on the h3. Three 221px columns is too narrow for Syne's wide extrabold.

findings.title: Gateways are generic cards with small looping SVG pictograms, not premium interactive visual gateways with service previews
findings.evidence: All three cards share one identical template: rounded-[2rem] #202342 tile, 8:5 dark inset, label, title, one sentence, 'Enter studio →', coloured blur glow. The 'previews' are abstract icons: four flat rectangles + a sine line (CREATE), a dashed empty box (BUILD), six purple bars (GROW). None shows an actual service: no reel frame with captions, no browser/site mock, no ad creative. No service names (V1-V5, T1-T5, M1-M3) appear although data/site.ts has them. This is exactly the 'generic SaaS cards' / 'repetitive glows' look the spec forbids, and reads as a template next to the hero.
findings.fix: Keep the three-link structure and staggered layout but make each card a tall visual gateway: CREATE = 9:16 reel frame with CSS-animated caption words, cut markers and a timeline strip; BUILD = mini browser chrome whose wireframe blocks resolve into a styled page; GROW = an illustrative social-ad card mock (no charts). Add 3-5 service chips from data/site.ts per card and make the visual fill most of the card (preview >= 60% of card height).

findings.title: No distinct motion identity per division; interaction is identical for all three
findings.evidence: Hover/focus behaviour is the same on every card: translate-y -8px (measured dy=-8), border to white/40, glow opacity 0.3->0.6, arrow shifts 6px (docs/audit/tmp/studios-hover-create.png). The only per-division difference is a tiny ambient SMIL loop (a line sliding, opacity pulsing - invisible because of the BUILD bug - and bars resizing). Nothing reacts to pointer, tap or scroll; there is no entrance/reveal motion at all for the heading or cards. Spec: 'distinct motion identity each', 'premium interactive gateways', 'varied professional motion ... not the same fade-up everywhere'.
findings.fix: Give each gateway its own language: CREATE = cut/scrub (playhead scrubs with pointer x or auto-plays in view, frames snap-cut, captions pop); BUILD = assemble (grid blocks draw in and snap to layout, wireframe->colour on hover/in-view); GROW = soft pulse/ripple signal with a calm 'beta' shimmer. Trigger on in-view (IntersectionObserver) so mobile gets it without hover, and add a mask/kinetic reveal for the headline.

findings.title: Three dark sections in a row: hero, studios and Live Transformation all sit on the same ink
findings.where: components/Studios.tsx:46 (bg-[#0c1024]); app/page.tsx order Hero > Studios > Transformation
findings.evidence: Computed backgrounds: previous section (hero) rgb(12,16,36); #studios rgb(12,16,36); next section linear-gradient(rgb(12,16,36) -> rgb(32,35,66)). Seam screenshots docs/audit/tmp/studios-seam-top-1440.png and studios-seam-bottom-1440.png show no visible boundary: same navy, same cyan letter-spaced eyebrow, same white+prism headline pattern ('Three worlds. Endless possibilities.' vs 'See the difference.'). Spec: 'Dark cinematic and light editorial sections must ALTERNATE; no two neighbouring sections may look alike.'
findings.fix: Make Studios the first light editorial section: paper #F6F7FC background, dark text #13172B, cards as rich coloured/visual panels (or white panels with full-bleed accent previews), a different heading composition (e.g. headline left, short intro right, or oversized CREATE/BUILD/GROW wordmarks). Drop the coloured blur glows here.

findings.title: SVG (SMIL) animations ignore prefers-reduced-motion
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce emulated, values still change over 1.2s: playhead x1 173.0 -> 277.0, GROW bar height 33.2 -> 37.2; 18 <animate> elements present. The global reduced-motion rule only shortens CSS animation/transition durations, which does not affect SMIL <animate>. These loops run forever (repeatCount=indefinite) with no pause control and also keep running off-screen.
findings.fix: Replace SMIL with CSS keyframe animations on classes (covered by the existing reduced-motion rule) or render a static finished frame when reduced motion is requested; pause when the section is off-screen.

findings.title: Leftover dead code: style={{ animation: 'marquee 0s' }} on the CREATE playhead group
findings.evidence: <g style={{ animation: "marquee 0s" }}> applies a 0-second keyframe animation that does nothing (marquee is defined in app/globals.css:31 for another purpose).
findings.fix: Remove the wrapper style; drive the playhead with a dedicated CSS keyframe.

findings.title: Cards are unbalanced on desktop: three different heights and misaligned content rows
findings.evidence: At 1440 card heights are 462 / 494 / 470px and tops are at 473 / 409 / 465px, so GROW sits 8px higher than CREATE for no design reason (title wraps to two lines, tagline to one). At 1024: 395 / 427 / 427. In docs/audit/1440-home-02-studios.png the verb labels, titles and 'Enter studio' rows of the outer cards do not line up. Spec asks for 'balanced on desktop'.
findings.fix: Give cards equal height (grid items-stretch, flex-col with mt-auto on the CTA row) and apply the stagger as a deliberate, consistent offset; reserve two lines for the title.

findings.title: Mobile is the desktop cards stacked, not recomposed; section is two full screens of near-identical tiles
findings.evidence: Section height is 1748px at 390 (viewport 844) and 1755px at 360; each card is 423-455px tall with the same layout as desktop (docs/audit/390-home-02-studios.png). All three are findable and tappable, but the third (GROW) starts ~1220px into the section and there is no overview of the three studios at a glance. At 360 the headline wraps to 4 lines (h2 height 160px vs 120px at 390). Spec: 'Mobile is recomposed, not shrunk.'
findings.fix: Recompose on phones: e.g. compact horizontal gateway rows (visual left, text right, ~180-220px tall) or a snap carousel with visible peeking and dots plus a three-chip CREATE/BUILD/GROW index under the headline so all three are discoverable in the first screen.

findings.title: 'ILLUSTRATIVE' label and BETA pill are too small to read
findings.where: components/Studios.tsx:39 (SVG text fontSize 11 in a 320 viewBox), :62 (text-[10px])
findings.evidence: The SVG label scales with the card: rendered text height is 7px at 768, 10px at 1024, 12-13px at 360/390, 15px at 1440 (it is also aria-hidden, so it is purely visual). The BETA pill is 10px type in a 56x25px pill at every width. The honesty signals are the least legible text in the section.
findings.fix: Render the 'Illustrative' caption and Beta label as HTML text at >= 12px (not scaled SVG text), with a filled lilac pill for Beta so it reads as a status, not decoration.

findings.title: Gateways carry no service content; 'Enter studio' label repeated three times
findings.evidence: Card text is only verb, name, one tagline and the identical visible link text 'Enter studio →' x3 (innerText measured). The spec asks for 'beautiful service previews'; the five CREATE, five BUILD and three GROW services already exist in data/site.ts but none is surfaced here.
findings.fix: Show service chips or a short list per gateway from s.services (e.g. 'Short-form · Long-form & podcast · Ads · Repurposing · Motion graphics') and use distinct CTAs: 'Enter CREATE', 'Enter BUILD', 'Preview GROW (Beta)'.

ownerTodos: Approve switching this section to a light 'paper' background so dark and light sections alternate (hero dark -> studios light -> transformation dark).
Approve the GROW wording on the gateway: 'Beta' only, or 'Beta - Coming Soon', and whether 'Join the beta list' should stay (it implies a waiting list exists).
Decide whether original 'Concept demo' stills or short clips may be produced for the CREATE gateway preview, or whether it should stay fully CSS/SVG-drawn.

audit:packages.summary: Section 5 (components/Packages.tsx, data/site.ts:61-85) is a light #f6f7fc section with the eyebrow "Packages & pricing", the correct headline "Find your starting point.", an honest intro line, three pill tabs (Video Editing / Website Development / Digital Marketing BETA) and a grid of identical white cards (4 for CREATE, 5 for BUILD, 1 for GROW), each with name, "for" line, three deliverables, an "Optional:" line and a text link. All three tabs work by click and by Tab+Enter, all 10 links navigate to /contact and pre-select the right studio, there is no sideways overflow at 360/390/768/1024/1440, and no prices, revision counts, delivery times or guarantees are invented. The weaknesses are that it looks exactly like a generic SaaS pricing grid with zero motion or division identity, the spec's "scope info" is absent, the chosen package name is discarded on the contact page, the tablist lacks arrow-key and ARIA wiring, and the GROW tab is a single orphaned card. Test script and screenshots are in /Users/raghusai/Desktop/CLAUDE 2.0/MAKENDLESSNWEBSITE/docs/audit/tmp/ (packages-test.mjs, packages-<width>-tab<0-2>.png, packages-1440-focus.png, packages-contact-*.png).
keep: Headline 'Find your starting point.' with the violet accent and the eyebrow: exact spec wording, strong Syne display type at 1440 and 390.

Honest intro copy (Packages.tsx:14): 'Every project is quoted from its real scope, effort and timeline... Prices are confirmed in a written proposal.' No invented prices, revision counts, delivery times or guarantees anywhere in data/site.ts:68-85.

'Request Quote' as the next action on every CREATE/BUILD card and 'Join the beta list' on GROW; all 10 links resolve to /contact?service=<studio>-<package> and pre-select the correct studio option (measured: create x4, build x5, grow x1).
GROW honesty: BETA chip on the tab plus the notice 'Digital marketing is in beta... No campaigns are offered yet.' and the contact option reads 'GROW — Digital marketing (beta interest)'.
Light paper background gives the required dark/light alternation and a brighter, clean feel.
Touch targets: tabs are 44px high, card links are 44px+ high at every width tested; visible focus ring on tabs (outline 2px solid, seen in packages-1440-focus.png).
No horizontal overflow at 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 (scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0 for every tab state); no page errors; Syne is the only computed font.
Package data lives in typed data/site.ts (Package interface) and maps cleanly to the service catalogue (Starter/Creator/Professional/Custom; Starter/Business/Commerce/Custom/Maintenance).
Mobile card text is readable at 390 (14px body, 20px titles, single column, no clipping on CREATE tab).

findings.title: Looks like a generic SaaS pricing table
findings.evidence: Four or five identical 243x310-330px white rounded cards in a row, each with title, grey subtitle, three dot bullets and a purple text link. No imagery, no division colour (CREATE and BUILD cards are pixel-identical in styling; bullets are aqua on both), no hierarchy between packages, no editorial composition. The spec explicitly says 'not a generic SaaS pricing table' and 'avoid generic SaaS cards'.
findings.fix: Keep the data and tabs but recompose the panel as an editorial layout: e.g. a large numbered list/accordion or a split view with one featured package detail (who it is for, deliverables, scope, add-ons, CTA) and a compact selector for the others; tint each category with its division accent (CREATE aqua, BUILD violet, GROW lilac) and add a small CSS/SVG motif per package (reel frame, browser wireframe) instead of bare bullets.

findings.title: Scope info / exclusions missing from every package
findings.evidence: The Package interface has only name, for, deliverables, addons. The spec for section 5 lists 'Package name, suitable customer, typical deliverables, scope info, optional additions, clear next action'. No card renders any scope line (what is included/not included, what the client supplies, that revisions and timeline are set in the proposal).
findings.fix: Add a `scope` field (and optionally `notIncluded`) to Package and render it as its own labelled row, using only non-invented statements, e.g. 'Scope: confirmed in a written proposal; revisions and timeline agreed before work starts' plus owner-approved exclusions. Put any exclusions the owner must decide into TODO-FOR-OWNER.md.

findings.title: Chosen package is dropped on the contact page
findings.evidence: All 10 links carry the package in the URL (/contact?service=build-commerce etc.) but the form keeps only the studio: for every link the select shows just 'CREATE — Video editing' / 'BUILD — Website development' / 'GROW — ...', the page text never mentions the package name (pageMentionsPackage=false for all 10) and the message textarea is empty. Clicking 'Request Quote' on Commerce and on Maintenance lands on an identical form (packages-contact-1-2.png).
findings.fix: Parse the full param in ContactForm, show a visible 'Requesting a quote for: BUILD — Commerce' chip (removable) and include it as a hidden/visible field in the submitted payload and mailto body; validate the slug against data/site.ts packages.

findings.title: Tablist has no arrow-key support and incomplete ARIA wiring
findings.evidence: Focusing the selected tab and pressing ArrowRight leaves selection on 'Video Editing' (kbArrow result). Tabs have no id, aria-controls or roving tabindex (all null); the panel is a <ul role="tabpanel"> with no aria-labelledby, and role=tabpanel on the UL removes list semantics so its <li> children are orphaned list items. The hero tablist does support arrow keys (scripts/shots.mjs tests it), so behaviour is inconsistent within the site.
findings.fix: Add Left/Right/Home/End handling with roving tabindex, give each tab an id and aria-controls, wrap the list in a <div role="tabpanel" id aria-labelledby tabIndex={0}> and keep the <ul> inside it.

findings.title: 'Maintenance' title overflows its card at 1024 and is jammed at 1440
findings.where: components/Packages.tsx:25 (h3 text-xl) with lg:grid-cols-4 / xl:grid-cols-5; docs/audit/tmp/packages-1024-tab1.png and packages-1440-tab1.png
findings.evidence: At 1024 the card is x=32, w=228 (right edge 260px) but the word 'Maintenance' runs to about x=270, past the card border. At 1440 (card 243px wide) the word ends about 5px from the card edge, inside the 24px padding. 'Professional' on the CREATE tab is likewise almost edge to edge.
findings.fix: Stop forcing five narrow columns: use at most 3-4 columns with wider cards (or the editorial list layout), or reduce title size / use clamp() and overflow-wrap so wide Syne ExtraBold words fit inside the padding.

findings.title: GROW tab is one small orphaned card with weak copy
findings.evidence: At 1440 a single 243px card sits at the left of a 1280px panel with roughly 1000px of empty space beside it; the title wraps to two lines and the CTA arrow drops alone onto a second line (link height 64px). The deliverable 'Informative beta descriptions' is not a deliverable and reads like placeholder text. The beta notice is a separate strip below rather than part of the composition.
findings.fix: Give GROW its own full-width beta layout: a wide lilac-tinted 'Coming soon' panel that lists the three planned areas (M1-M3) as 'planned, not yet offered', merges the beta notice into it, and has one clear 'Join the beta list' button. Replace 'Informative beta descriptions' with honest wording such as 'Updates when beta opens'.

findings.title: 'Join the beta list' implies a list that does not exist
findings.evidence: The link goes to the general Start a Project form with GROW pre-selected; there is no beta-list mechanism and, with no NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL, submitting ends in 'Form checked. Delivery channel pending... this message was not sent anywhere.' The card promises 'Early-access updates'.
findings.fix: Rename to 'Register beta interest' until a real list/delivery channel is approved, and keep the 'Early-access updates' promise only if the owner commits to sending them.

findings.title: No motion at all; tab change is an instant swap
findings.evidence: 0 animations in the section; the only transition is the tab pill colour. Cards have no entrance, no hover/focus state (only the link underlines on hover) and the panel content pops in. Section height also jumps between tabs at 1440 (854px / 834px / 930px), shifting everything below. The spec asks for varied professional motion and per-division identity.
findings.fix: Add a restrained panel transition on tab change (staggered mask/slide reveal, reduced-motion safe), a card hover/focus state, and reserve a min-height for the panel so the page below does not jump.

findings.title: Empty fifth column and awkward orphan rows
findings.where: components/Packages.tsx:22 (`sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5`); docs/audit/1440-home-05-packages.png; docs/audit/tmp/packages-1024-tab1.png, packages-768-tab1.png
findings.evidence: At 1440 the CREATE tab's four cards end at x=1101 leaving a 259px empty column on the right, so the grid looks left-heavy under a full-width headline. On BUILD at 1024 and 768 the fifth card (Maintenance) sits alone on its own row with empty space beside it.
findings.fix: Set the column count from the number of packages (4 columns for CREATE), and treat Maintenance as a distinct full-width 'after launch' strip rather than a fifth equal card.

findings.title: CTA arrow wraps onto its own line at 1024
findings.evidence: At 1024 every 'Request Quote →' link is 64px high (two lines) with the arrow alone on line two; the same happens for 'Join the beta list →' at 1440 and 1024.
findings.fix: Make the arrow a non-wrapping inline element (whitespace-nowrap on the link or a no-break space before the arrow) and style the CTA as a proper button so it reads as the primary action.

findings.title: Mobile is the desktop grid stacked, producing a very long section
findings.evidence: At 390 the section is 1816px tall on CREATE and 2106px on BUILD (about 2.5 phone screens of near-identical cards). The three tabs wrap into three separate left-aligned rows of different widths (143 / 214 / 227px) taking about 150px of height. The spec says mobile must be recomposed, not shrunk.
findings.fix: On phones use a full-width three-segment control (short labels: Video / Web / Marketing BETA) and collapse packages into an accordion or a horizontal snap carousel with a position indicator, showing one package in full at a time.

findings.title: Small supporting text sizes
findings.where: components/Packages.tsx:18 (text-[10px] BETA chip), :30 (text-xs Optional line), :12 (text-xs eyebrow)
findings.evidence: Computed sizes: BETA chip 10px, 'Optional:' add-ons line 12px, eyebrow 12px at all widths including 360/390. The add-ons line is real content, not decoration.
findings.fix: Raise the add-ons line to 13-14px on mobile and the BETA chip to at least 11-12px.

findings.title: Section has no anchor id
findings.evidence: The <section> has aria-labelledby but no id, so nothing (nav, studio pages, Solutions CTAs) can deep-link to packages and a tab cannot be opened by URL.
findings.fix: Add id="packages" and optionally read a hash/query (e.g. #packages?tab=build) to pre-select the category.

ownerTodos: Approve the scope wording and any exclusions per package (what is and is not included, what the client must supply). None exists in data/site.ts today and it must not be invented.
Confirm the package names and groupings (CREATE: Starter / Creator / Professional / Custom; BUILD: Starter / Business / Commerce / Custom / Maintenance) and the add-on lists.
Decide whether a real GROW beta interest list will exist and whether 'Early-access updates' will actually be sent; otherwise the CTA should say 'Register beta interest'.
Approve a delivery channel for the contact form (NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL or a backend) so Request Quote enquiries, including the selected package, actually reach the team.
The FAQ says revision limits are defined per package; supply those limits for the written proposal or confirm they stay proposal-only and off the site.

audit:project-form.summary: The /contact page is a generic PageShell (eyebrow + H1 + intro) followed by a bare four-field form (Name, Email, service select, message) in components/ContactForm.tsx (49 lines). Client validation works and the no-backend result is literally honest (no network request, text says "was not sent anywhere"), but there is no loading state, no real error state, no usable success path, and the result panel shows developer text (an env var name) to the visitor and dead-ends them. Query-string preselection only half works (?service= maps to the studio, package name is dropped; ?for= does nothing at all), the H1 causes sideways scrolling at 360 and 390, and the form is absent from the server HTML. Visually it is the weakest, most template-looking page on the site: a single narrow column on a flat dark background with a 160px dead gap above it.
keep: Honesty baseline: with no NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL, a valid submit makes zero non-GET requests (measured) and the panel explicitly says the message 'was not sent anywhere'. No false 'sent' message. Keep that principle, rewrite the wording.

The validation rules and friendly error copy ('Please tell us your name.', 'Enter a valid email address.', 'Tell us a little more (at least 10 characters).') and the noValidate + custom-message approach.
aria-invalid toggles correctly per field and aria-describedby points at the error span once it exists (name/email/message).
Every control is wrapped in a <label>, so all four have accessible names; autocomplete=name/email are set; email input is type=email.
Keyboard: logical tab order (skip link, nav, name, email, select, textarea, button), Enter in an input submits, and all controls show the 2px #22d3ee focus-visible outline (globals.css:26).
Touch sizing: inputs 54px, select 51px, button 56px tall; 16px input font size so iOS does not zoom on focus; full-width submit button on mobile.
Syne is applied to inputs, select and labels (computed font-family verified); one H1; page title 'Start a Project — MAKENDLESS'.
Spec copy is used verbatim: 'Let's make something worth remembering.' / 'Tell us what you're building. We'll help you take the next step.'
GROW option is honestly labelled 'GROW — Digital marketing (beta interest)'.
?service=create|build|grow (and create-starter etc.) correctly preselects the studio in the select.
No invented contact details, response times or policies anywhere on the page.

findings.title: Result panel shows developer text to the visitor and is a dead end
findings.evidence: After a valid submit the form is replaced by: 'Form checked. Delivery channel pending. The inquiry inbox isn't connected yet, so this message was not sent anywhere. The team needs to set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL or a form backend before launch.' It is honest, but it exposes an environment variable name to customers, discards everything the visitor typed (form unmounted, no state kept), and the panel contains 0 links/buttons (measured: resultDom.links = 0) - no way back to the form, no copy of the brief, no next step. The spec asks for a fully built success state AND an honest one; this is a developer placeholder, not a designed state.
findings.fix: Keep the honesty, redesign the state for a customer: a designed 'Your brief is ready - but not sent' panel that shows a readable summary of what they entered, a 'Copy brief' button (clipboard), an 'Edit brief' button that restores the form with values intact, and plain wording such as 'Online sending isn't switched on yet, so nothing has been sent.' Remove the env var name from user-facing copy (keep it in README/TODO-FOR-OWNER). Build the real success state ('Brief received') behind a delivery flag so it can never render while no delivery service is configured.

findings.title: No loading state and no submission-error state exist
findings.evidence: State is just err + done. Submit to result took 69ms with no pending UI; the button never disables or changes label; there is no code path for a failed delivery (no try/catch, no error panel, no retry). Spec: 'Fully built: fields, validation, loading, success and error states.'
findings.fix: Model status as idle | validating/submitting | success | not-delivered | error. Add a submit adapter (single function returning ok / not-configured / failed) with no service wired. While pending: disable the button, aria-busy on the form, label 'Checking your brief...'. Error state: role=alert panel with the visitor's data preserved and a Retry button. Not-configured maps to the honest 'not sent' panel; success is only reachable when the adapter reports real delivery.

findings.title: Sideways scrolling at 360 and 390: H1 word 'remembering.' overflows the viewport
findings.where: components/PageShell.tsx:8 (h1 text-4xl) on /contact at 360 and 390; screenshots docs/audit/390-page-contact.png, docs/audit/tmp/contact-390-top2.png
findings.evidence: Measured at both 360 and 390: documentElement.scrollWidth = 421 vs clientWidth 360/390; h1 font 36px, h1.scrollWidth 401 > clientWidth 320/350; the gradient span's second line spans x=20 to 421. The screenshot shows 'remembering' cut off at the right edge with the full stop lost, and the existing 390 audit screenshot is 421px wide for the same reason. Spec: 'No sideways scrolling.' (Side effect seen in testing: the widened layout viewport offsets the visual viewport, so coordinate taps landed 64px off.)
findings.fix: Use a fluid size for the page H1, e.g. font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 8.2vw, 3.75rem) so 'remembering.' fits in 320px of content width at 360, and add overflow-wrap: anywhere / hyphens as a safety net. Re-measure scrollWidth === clientWidth at 360, 390 and 768.

findings.title: ?for= preselection does nothing (Solutions section CTA context is lost)
findings.evidence: Solutions links to /contact?for=creator|local|startup|store. ContactForm does `(service || for || 'other').split('-')[0]` and then checks it against create/build/grow/other, so every ?for= value falls back to 'Not sure yet'. Measured: ?for=local, ?for=creator, ?for=startup, ?for=store all give select value 'other', no other visible change on the page.
findings.fix: Add a real 'I am a...' field (Content creator / Local business / Startup / Online store / Other - values from data/site.ts solutions) and preselect it from ?for=. Optionally also preselect the studio from that solution's first recommended service. Show a small removable context chip, e.g. 'Starting as: Local business'.

findings.title: Package name from 'Request Quote' links is thrown away
findings.evidence: Packages links to /contact?service=create-starter, create-creator, create-professional, create-custom (hrefs read from the live homepage). The form keeps only the part before the first hyphen: ?service=create-starter gives select 'create', textarea empty, and no mention of 'Starter' anywhere on the page (visibleContext false). A visitor who clicked a specific package arrives at a form that has forgotten it, and the mailto body (line 25) would not include it either.
findings.fix: Parse studio and package separately, validate both against data/site.ts, and add a dependent 'Package' select (options for the chosen studio plus 'Not sure / Custom') preselected from the query. Show it in the brief summary and include it in the submitted payload.

findings.title: Form is too thin for a real project brief
findings.where: components/ContactForm.tsx:42-46 (fields: name, email, service, message only)
findings.evidence: DOM field list is exactly [name, email, service, message]. Nothing captures who the customer is, which package, project type, existing links, timing or budget, so every inquiry would need a follow-up round. No field is marked required or optional (0 elements with required/aria-required), and there is no helper text or placeholder guidance on the message box.
findings.fix: Add, without inventing any policy or figure: (1) Customer type (four spec types + other); (2) Package / service detail driven by data/site.ts (V1-V5, T1-T5, M1-M3 as multi-select chips per studio); (3) Business or channel name (optional); (4) Links - current website, channel or sample footage (optional URL field); (5) Timing as free text or neutral choices ('As soon as possible / Within a month or two / Flexible / Not sure') with no promised delivery times; (6) Budget as an optional free-text field ('Share a rough budget if you have one') - do NOT add price brackets, since no prices are approved; (7) Preferred contact method only if the owner approves phone/WhatsApp (owner decision); (8) A consent line linking to /privacy. Mark required fields visibly and with aria-required, and add a short hint under the message field (what to include). Consider a 2-3 step layout (You / Project / Details) so the longer form stays calm on mobile.

findings.title: Page looks like an unstyled template: single narrow column, 160px dead gap, half the screen empty
findings.evidence: At 1440 the form occupies x=208-880 and the right ~45% of the page is empty flat #0c1024. Measured gap between the hero text block and the form: 160px (pb-16 + py-24 of two stacked same-colour sections). At 1440x900 the first field starts at y=620, so only Name, Email and the top of the select are above the fold. Header and body are the same dark colour, so the spec's dark/light alternation and 'portfolio-grade, not a template' bar are not met. The select uses the native browser chevron, which looks out of place against the custom rounded fields.
findings.fix: Recompose as a two-column layout at >=1024: form on the left, on the right a sticky 'What happens next' rail built from the existing DISCOVER / DESIGN / CREATE / DELIVER steps plus a live brief summary that fills in as the visitor types (CSS/SVG only, no 3D on this page per spec). Pull the form up so it starts above the fold (cut the gap to ~48px or merge the sections). Put the form on a light paper (#F6F7FC) card or section for contrast with the dark header. Replace the service select with three large studio choice cards using the division accents (aqua / violet / lilac, GROW tagged Beta), and style any remaining select with appearance-none plus a custom chevron.

findings.title: Errors are not announced and focus is not managed
findings.evidence: After an empty submit: 0 elements with role=alert or aria-live in the document, and document.activeElement stays on the BUTTON (measured) - a screen-reader user hears nothing. After a successful submit the focused button is unmounted and focus drops to BODY; the role=status div is inserted already populated, which many screen readers do not announce. At 768 the first error ended up at y=97 only by luck of scroll position; nothing scrolls the first invalid field into view.
findings.fix: On failed validation, focus the first invalid field (and scroll it into view with scroll-margin for the fixed header) and render a role=alert summary above the form ('3 fields need attention') with links to each field. On result, move focus to the result heading (tabIndex=-1) and keep a persistent, initially empty live region that the message is written into.

findings.title: Error text is nested inside the <label>, polluting the accessible name; aria-describedby points at missing ids when valid
findings.evidence: After an empty submit the Name input's label text is 'NamePlease tell us your name.' (input.labels[0].textContent), so the error is read as part of the name and again as the description. In the initial state aria-describedby references e-name / e-email / e-msg, none of which exist in the DOM (measured exists:false).
findings.fix: Use

findings.title: Errors do not clear when the visitor fixes the field
findings.evidence: With 'bad@email' flagged, typing '.com' to make it valid left 'Enter a valid email address.' and aria-invalid=true in place (measured afterFixTyping) until the next submit.
findings.fix: Make fields controlled (also needed to preserve values across states) and re-validate a field on change once it has been flagged, or on blur.

findings.title: Form is missing from server HTML (blank until JS hydrates)
findings.evidence: curl of /contact returns 0 occurrences of '<form' and contains BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING; with JavaScript disabled the page has no form at all (noJS.form = false). The main content of the page pops in after hydration with an empty hole before it.
findings.fix: Render the form on the server: read searchParams in the page (server component) and pass initial values as props, or at minimum give Suspense a skeleton fallback with the same dimensions. Add a <noscript> note.

findings.title: Validation is loose and inputs are unbounded
findings.evidence: Name 'X', email 'a@b.c' and message 'aaaaaaaaaa' pass and reach the result panel (junkAccepted = true). No maxlength on any field (0 elements with maxlength). Submit button has no explicit type attribute.
findings.fix: Trim values, require a 2+ character TLD, add sensible maxlength (name 80, message ~2000 with a live counter), and set type='submit' explicitly. When a delivery service is later approved, add a honeypot field.

findings.title: mailto branch (if the env var is set) claims the mail app is opening without knowing
findings.where: components/ContactForm.tsx:24-28, 34-35 (code path not active in the running build)
findings.evidence: Code reading only: when NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL is set, the form sets window.location.href to a mailto: URL and replaces itself with 'Your email app should be opening.' If no mail client is configured nothing happens, the typed brief is gone, and the address is never shown as a fallback. The mailto body also omits any package/customer-type context.
findings.fix: In that branch keep the brief on screen, show the address as visible selectable text with 'Copy address' and 'Copy brief' buttons, and word it as 'If your email app didn't open, copy the brief below and email it to ...'. Never describe this as sent.

findings.title: favicon.ico returns 404
findings.evidence: Console error 'Failed to load resource: 404' and response log shows /favicon.ico 404 on the contact page load.
findings.fix: Add app/icon.svg (or favicon.ico) with the MAKENDLESS mark.

ownerTodos: Approve a delivery channel for the form (inbox address or form backend). Until then the form must keep saying nothing was sent.
Decide whether an email address may be shown publicly on the contact page (currently none, per 'no invented contact details').
Decide whether to ask for budget at all, and if so whether as free text only (no price brackets can be shown since no prices are approved).
Decide whether phone / WhatsApp may be offered as a preferred contact method.
Approve the wording for what happens after a brief is received (no response-time promise can be written without owner sign-off).
Confirm the privacy/consent sentence to show next to the submit button and that /privacy covers form data.

audit:shared.summary: The shared foundation is small and functional: a 53-line globals.css with a Tailwind 4 @theme token block, a root layout loading Syne via next/font with a working skip link, a fixed blurred Nav (4 links + Start a Project, hamburger under 768px), a 3-column Footer, and a PageShell used by all internal pages. All 10 routes and every nav/footer link return HTTP 200, there is no sideways scroll at 360/390/768/1024/1440, and focus rings are present. What is missing is the finishing layer: the tokens are declared but never used (320 hard-coded hex literals in components), there is no favicon/OG/robots/sitemap (public/ is empty), no custom 404, and the mobile menu has no Escape, scroll-lock, focus containment or overflow handling. The nav also degrades visibly over the light sections. Test scripts and screenshots are in /Users/raghusai/Desktop/CLAUDE 2.0/MAKENDLESSNWEBSITE/docs/audit/tmp/ (foundation-test.mjs, foundation-test2.mjs, foundation-*.png).
keep: Wordmark treatment (MAKEND + prism-gradient LESS, wide tracking) in nav and footer - distinctive and consistent; keep exactly.
Syne-only font loading via next/font with display swap (layout.tsx:6); document.fonts confirms only Syne 400-800 plus its fallback is loaded on shipped pages.
Skip link (layout.tsx:18): first Tab stop, clearly visible white pill with cyan ring (tmp/foundation-skiplink-1440.png), and activating it moves the tab sequence past the header into main.
Global :focus-visible rule (globals.css:26) - 2px #22d3ee outline with 3px offset applies to every link/button; clearly visible on dark surfaces (tmp/foundation-footer-focus.png).
Global prefers-reduced-motion block (globals.css:34-36); computed scroll-behavior switches to auto under reduced motion.
Hamburger button: 44x44, correct aria-expanded / aria-controls / aria-label toggling ('Open menu'/'Close menu'), animated icon; mobile menu rows are 61px tall and the CTA 52px - comfortable targets.
Mobile menu closes on link tap and on wordmark tap, and unmounts cleanly when resized to desktop.

All nav and footer links resolve: /, /studios, /about, /faq, /contact, /create, /build, /grow, /privacy, /terms all HTTP 200; footer contains exactly the spec list including 'GROW — Beta'; no invented contact details.
Footer structure: three labelled <nav> groups with headings, honest copyright line, CREATE • BUILD • GROW tagline.
Per-page titles via the '%s — MAKENDLESS' template; exactly one h1 and one main per page; html lang='en'; themeColor set.
No horizontal overflow at 360/390/768/820/1024/1440 (scrollWidth == viewport); desktop nav fits at 768 without wrapping (tmp/foundation-nav-768.png).
PageShell dark hero band + light/dark body pattern with eyebrow/h1/intro - a sound reusable base; 'Explore Studios' anchor lands with the heading 160px below the fixed nav (not hidden).

findings.title: Colour tokens are declared but never used - 320 hard-coded hex literals across components
findings.where: app/globals.css:3-17 vs components/*.tsx and app/*/page.tsx (e.g. components/Nav.tsx:23,28,30,41,45; components/PageShell.tsx:5,7,9,12; components/FinalCta.tsx:11,13,15,16,19)
findings.evidence: grep of #RRGGBB in app/ + components/ *.tsx: 320 occurrences, 69 distinct values, in 19 files (HeroScreens 75, Transformation 67, Hero3D 30, Hero 29, Solutions 24, Packages 18...). Uses of token utilities (bg-ink, text-muted, text-dark, bg-paper etc.): 0. Uses of var(--color-*/--prism): 5. Most-repeated literals are exactly the tokens: #13172b x44, #22d3ee x34, #a4aac7 x27, #0c1024 x27, #c7a6ff x25, #6f45f6 x20. Near-duplicate off-palette greys have crept in (#7a8099, #5b607a, #59607f beside token #5a6082). The BUILD accent #8b5cf6 (x19) has no token at all; the prism gradient lives in :root not @theme; globals.css itself hard-codes #6f45f6 (line 23) and #22d3ee (lines 26, 52). data/site.ts:21,36,52 also hard-codes accents. Spec: 'Centralised tokens in app/globals.css'.
findings.fix: Add missing tokens to @theme (--color-create #22d3ee, --color-build #8b5cf6, --color-grow #c7a6ff, --color-focus, gradient as --background-image-prism or keep --prism), then mechanically replace arbitrary values with utilities: bg-[#0c1024]->bg-ink, text-[#a4aac7]->text-muted, text-[#13172b]->text-dark, bg-[#f6f7fc]->bg-paper, etc. Collapse the stray greys onto muted / muted-dark. For Three.js materials and inline styles export a typed palette object from one file (e.g. data/tokens.ts) mirroring the CSS tokens. Start with the shared files (Nav, PageShell, FinalCta) then the sections.

findings.title: No custom 404 - default Next.js page, off-brand and a dead end
findings.evidence: tmp/foundation-404-1440.png: pure black (#000) body instead of ink, default system-font '404 | This page could not be found.', no footer, zero links inside main (measured: links [], hasFooter false). Title is the generic home title. Breaks 'Syne only' and the portfolio-grade bar; the only way out is the nav.
findings.fix: Add app/not-found.tsx using PageShell (eyebrow '404', on-brand headline such as 'This frame got cut.', short line, two real CTAs: Back to home, Start a Project) with metadata title 'Page not found'. Keep it CSS-only (no 3D).

findings.title: No favicon, app icons, Open Graph / Twitter metadata, robots or sitemap; public/ is empty
findings.evidence: curl: all five return 404. Every page load logs a console error '404 http://localhost:3456/favicon.ico'. Rendered <head> on all 10 routes has no link[rel=icon], no og:* and no twitter:* tags, no canonical (measured per page: og false, tw false, canon false, icon false). No metadataBase. Shared links will show a blank preview and the tab shows the default globe.
findings.fix: Add app/icon.svg (an 'M' or the prism LESS mark on ink) plus app/apple-icon.png, app/opengraph-image.tsx (generated with next/og: wordmark + headline on ink with prism gradient), openGraph/twitter blocks in layout metadata, app/robots.ts and app/sitemap.ts. metadataBase needs the real production domain - owner input; until then leave it environment-driven (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL) rather than inventing a domain.

findings.title: Every page shares the same meta description
findings.evidence: Each page exports only { title }; measured description on all 10 routes is the identical home string 'We make ideas impossible to ignore. Premium video editing...'. /grow title is just 'GROW — MAKENDLESS' with no Beta marker.
findings.fix: Add a one-sentence description per page drawn from data/site.ts (no new claims), and title GROW as 'GROW (Beta)'.

findings.title: Mobile menu ignores Escape and has no outside-tap close
findings.evidence: foundation-test.mjs: after opening, pressing Escape -> '#mobile-menu' still present (true); tapping the page below the panel -> still present (true). There is no keydown handler anywhere in Nav.tsx. Only the X button, a link tap or the wordmark close it. Spec: full keyboard support.
findings.fix: In Nav add a useEffect while open: keydown Escape -> setOpen(false) and return focus to the toggle button (ref); add a transparent backdrop button/div below the panel that closes on click; also close on pathname change via usePathname.

findings.title: Open mobile menu does not lock scroll or contain focus - page scrolls and tabs behind it
findings.evidence: With menu open, scrollTo(1500) succeeded (scrollY 1500, body overflow-y auto) and the panel floats over mid-page content with no dimming (tmp/foundation-menu-390-scrolled.png shows Studios cards scrolling under the open menu). Tab order from the toggle: Studios, About, FAQ, Contact, Start a Project, then straight into 'PAGE-BEHIND Start a Project', 'PAGE-BEHIND Explore Studios' (hero). main has no inert attribute; the panel has no dialog semantics. The hero canvas and timeline remain interactive directly under the panel (docs/audit/390-mobile-menu.png).
findings.fix: While open: set document.documentElement.style.overflow='hidden' (restore on close), set inert on <main> (or trap Tab within header), and render a full-height ink backdrop (fixed inset-0 top-16, bg-ink/80 backdrop-blur) so the menu reads as a deliberate full-screen overlay rather than a dropdown over a live 3D scene.

findings.title: Mobile menu is cut off in landscape - Start a Project unreachable
findings.where: components/Nav.tsx:23,41; viewport 667x375 (phone landscape, still below md)
findings.evidence: Measured: menu bottom = 417px, viewport height = 375px; header is position:fixed with overflow visible and the menu has overflow-y visible, so the overflow cannot be scrolled to. tmp/foundation-menu-landscape.png shows the white 'Start a Project' pill sliced by the bottom edge with only ~34px of its 52px visible.
findings.fix: Give the panel max-h-[calc(100dvh-4rem)] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain (and tighten row padding under a max-height media query), or switch the panel to a fixed inset-x-0 top-16 bottom-0 scrollable overlay.

findings.title: Sticky nav turns muddy grey over light sections and link contrast drops below AA
findings.where: components/Nav.tsx:23 (bg-[#0c1024]/70 backdrop-blur-xl) and :28 (text-[#a4aac7]); home Packages / Process sections and every light PageShell body, 1440 and 390
findings.evidence: tmp/foundation-navlight-1440.png and tmp/foundation-menu-over-light-390.png: over #f6f7fc the bar becomes a washed slate grey (70% ink over paper computes to about rgb(82,85,101)) with dark smears of blurred headline text bleeding through, and a heavy grey slab against the clean editorial section. Nav links #a4aac7 on that grey = about 3.2:1 contrast (needs 4.5:1 for 14px text). On mobile the grey bar sits on top of the solid-ink menu panel, so the header and its own menu are two different colours.
findings.fix: Make the bar section-aware or simply more opaque: bg-ink/92 with backdrop-blur (keeps the glass feel on dark, stays ink over light), or use an IntersectionObserver / data-theme on sections to swap to a paper/85 bar with dark text over light sections. Raise link colour to #c9cde0 or white/80. When the mobile menu is open force the bar to solid ink.

findings.title: Desktop nav and footer link hit areas are far below 44px (desktop nav is what touch tablets get at 768+)
findings.where: components/Nav.tsx:28,30 (header links) and components/FinalCta.tsx:16 (footer links); measured at 768, 1024, 1440, 390, 360
findings.evidence: Measured rects: header links Studios 46x20, About 37x20, FAQ 26x20, Contact 51x20; header CTA 150x36; wordmark link 246x28. Footer links are 19px tall at every width including 390/360 (CREATE 58x19, FAQ 30x19, Terms 43x19) on a 36px pitch (space-y-3). Spec: touch targets >= 44px. A 768px iPad portrait gets the 20px-tall desktop links.
findings.fix: Header: make links inline-flex h-11 items-center px-3 (reduce gap-8 to gap-2 to compensate) and CTA h-11. Footer: links as inline-flex min-h-11 items-center with space-y-0 (or py-3 -my-1), so each row is a 44px target without changing the visual rhythm much.

findings.title: Focus ring colour is nearly invisible on light sections
findings.where: app/globals.css:26 and :52 (outline: 2px solid #22d3ee) applied site-wide including bg-[#f6f7fc] sections
findings.evidence: The single global ring colour #22d3ee against paper #f6f7fc computes to roughly 1.7:1 contrast (WCAG non-text minimum is 3:1); it is strong only on ink (see tmp/foundation-footer-focus.png). Light sections are Packages, Process+FAQ and the body of most internal pages including the contact form.
findings.fix: Tokenise the ring: --color-focus: #22d3ee by default, and inside light sections (a .theme-light / [data-theme=light] wrapper applied by PageShell light and the light home sections) set it to violet #6f45f6 (about 5:1 on paper). Alternatively use a two-tone ring: outline 2px #22d3ee plus box-shadow 0 0 0 5px #0c1024.

findings.title: No current-page indication in the navigation
findings.evidence: On /about every header link has aria-current null and identical colour rgb(164,170,199); same in the mobile menu. Users get no 'you are here' cue.
findings.fix: Use usePathname(); set aria-current='page' and an active style (white text plus a 2px prism underline) on the matching link in both desktop and mobile lists.

findings.title: Footer is nested inside <main> and reads as a plain link sitemap
findings.where: components/PageShell.tsx:13, components/FinalCta.tsx:4-22 rendered within app/layout.tsx:20 <main id="main">; docs/audit/1440-home-08-footer.png, 390-home-08-footer.png
findings.evidence: DOM check: document.querySelector('main footer') is truthy on every page, so the footer is not exposed as the page contentinfo landmark and the skip link target contains it (on /about the first Tab after skipping lands on the footer wordmark). Visually it is a flat ink panel with three default-weight link columns and no closing gesture - competent but template-level next to the hero; a large empty area sits under the wordmark at 1440.
findings.fix: Render <Footer/> once in app/layout.tsx after </main> and remove it from PageShell and FinalCta. Polish without restarting: oversized outlined/prism MAKENDLESS wordmark as a closing band, GROW link with a small Beta pill instead of the dash text, a thin prism hairline as the top border, and hover underline motion per division colour.

findings.title: Wordmark accessible name relies on aria-label on a plain span
findings.evidence: <span aria-label="MAKENDLESS"> has no role; aria-label on a generic element is not reliably honoured, so the home link can be announced as 'MAKEND LESS' (two text nodes). The home link also has no 'home' hint.
findings.fix: Move the label to the link: <Link href="/" aria-label="MAKENDLESS — home"> and mark the inner spans aria-hidden.

findings.title: Mobile menu appears with no transition and duplicates the Contact destination
findings.evidence: The panel is conditionally mounted ({open && ...}) with no enter/exit motion, so it snaps in over the live hero; it is a plain list of four words. Both 'Contact' and 'Start a Project' point to /contact in the desktop bar and in the menu, while the three studios (the core offer) are not reachable from the mobile menu at all without going through /studios.
findings.fix: Animate the overlay (mask/clip-path reveal with staggered link rise, instant under reduced motion). Consider replacing the redundant 'Contact' text link with nothing, or in the mobile overlay add a compact CREATE / BUILD / GROW (Beta) row in division colours under 'Studios'. Keep primary nav simple per spec.

ownerTodos: Production domain (needed for metadataBase, canonical URLs, sitemap and Open Graph URLs) - must not be invented.
Approve a favicon / app-icon mark (e.g. 'M' monogram or the prism 'LESS' fragment) and the social share (Open Graph) image design.
Approve 404 page wording.
Decide whether the primary nav keeps both 'Contact' and 'Start a Project' (same destination) or drops the text link.

audit:solutions.summary: Section 4 (components/Solutions.tsx, 52 lines) is a dark #0c1024 block with the correct headline, a four-button tablist (Content creator / Local business / Startup / Online store) and one panel holding a small flat SVG icon, a headline, blurb, service chips and two CTAs. Mouse and tap selection genuinely swap the SVG, headline, blurb, chips and the Start a Project href at all five widths, with no horizontal overflow (0px at 360/390/768/1024/1440) and Syne throughout. It is functionally the thinnest section on the homepage: arrow keys do nothing, the ?for= parameter is dropped by the contact form, the scenes are crude 5-10 primitive icons, there is no transition motion, and it is the fourth consecutive dark section. Test script: /Users/raghusai/Desktop/CLAUDE 2.0/MAKENDLESSNWEBSITE/docs/audit/tmp/solutions-test.mjs; screenshots are solutions-*.png in the same folder.
keep: Headline 'Made for what you're building.' with the prism gradient on 'you're building.' matches the spec and reads strongly at 1440 and 390.
The four customer types and their order match the spec; clicking or tapping really changes headline, blurb, chips, SVG and CTA href (verified for all four tabs at 1440, 1024, 768, 390, 360).
Copy in data/site.ts solutions (lines 96-99) is short, human and specific per audience, e.g. 'Be easy to find. Easy to book.' and 'Look ready before you are.'

Service chips are colour-coded by studio accent (CREATE aqua rgb(34,211,238), BUILD violet rgb(139,92,246), GROW lilac rgb(199,166,255)), and GROW is labelled 'Marketing (beta)' on Startup and Online store.
Data-driven structure: typed solutions array in data/site.ts as the single source, studio accents looked up from studios.
Mobile recomposition: 2x2 tab grid above the panel at 390/360, tabs 56-74px tall, CTAs 44-46px tall, no sideways scroll.
Both CTAs are real links: Explore Services goes to /studios (h1 'Three worlds. Endless possibilities.'), Start a Project goes to /contact?for=<id>.
Enter/Space on a focused tab selects it, and a 2px focus outline is present on tabs (measured outline: solid 2px, :focus-visible true).
No 3D is used here, which is correct per the spec (3D only in Hero, Live Transformation, Final CTA).

findings.title: Arrow keys do nothing on the customer-type tabs
findings.evidence: With focus on the first tab, pressing ArrowDown, ArrowRight, End and Home left selection and focus on 'Content creator' every time. There is no onKeyDown handler in the file. All four tabs have tabindex=null (no roving tabindex), so Tab walks through all four: measured order was Local business, Startup, Online store, Explore Services, Start a Project. The hero tablist on the same page does support arrows (scripts/shots.mjs tabKeyboard test), so behaviour is inconsistent.
findings.fix: Add an onKeyDown on the tablist: ArrowRight/ArrowDown next, ArrowLeft/ArrowUp previous, Home/End first/last, with wrap-around; move focus to the newly selected tab; set tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}. Reuse the hero tablist's pattern.

findings.title: Tab/panel ARIA wiring is incomplete
findings.evidence: DOM check on all four tabs: id=null, aria-controls=null; tabpanel has id=null and aria-labelledby=null. The panel is not announced as belonging to the selected tab and content changes are not exposed to assistive tech.
findings.fix: Give each tab id=`sol-tab-${id}` and aria-controls="sol-panel"; give the panel id="sol-panel", aria-labelledby the active tab id and tabIndex={0}.

findings.title: Start a Project passes ?for=<customer> but the contact form ignores it
findings.evidence: Clicking the CTA from Content creator lands on /contact?for=creator, from Online store on /contact?for=store. In both cases the service select value is 'other' ('Not sure yet') and the message textarea is empty. ContactForm only has options create/build/grow/other, so 'creator', 'local', 'startup', 'store' never match. The per-tab href is therefore cosmetic: the visitor's choice is lost.
findings.fix: Map the customer type in ContactForm: creator -> create, local/startup/store -> build (or add a 'What are you building?' field prefilled with the customer label), and show a visible line such as 'Starting a project for: Online store' so the selection carries through.

findings.title: Fourth consecutive dark section; breaks the dark/light alternation rule
findings.evidence: Computed backgrounds in page order: hero rgb(12,16,36), studios rgb(12,16,36), live transformation gradient rgb(12,16,36)->rgb(32,35,66), solutions rgb(12,16,36), packages rgb(246,247,252), process/FAQ rgb(246,247,252), final CTA rgb(12,16,36). Solutions is the identical flat ink colour as Studios two sections up, and four dark sections run back to back before two light ones. Spec: dark cinematic and light editorial sections must alternate; no two neighbouring sections may look alike; avoid a uniformly dark site. Also the Transformation section ends at #202342 and Solutions starts at #0c1024, producing a hard seam.
findings.fix: Make this section the light editorial break: paper #F6F7FC background, dark text #13172B, with the selected-customer panel as the one dark or accent-tinted stage. Packages then needs to differ from it (the packages/process pair is already two light sections in a row), so coordinate: e.g. Solutions light, Packages light-tinted with a clearly different composition, or Solutions light and Packages on a surface-coloured band.

findings.title: SVG scenes are crude placeholder icons, not business-specific visuals
findings.where: components/Solutions.tsx:8-17; screenshots docs/audit/tmp/solutions-1440-tab0.png to tab3.png and solutions-scene0-3.png
findings.evidence: Each scene is 5-10 flat primitives in a 300x200 viewBox: creator = one purple rectangle with a play triangle, two cyan bars and a progress line; local business = an empty browser outline with two grey bars, a pill and a single-stroke 'awning'; startup = a clip-art rocket; store = three identical purple squares with two bars each. No text, no content, no depth, nothing that says cafe/salon/booking, product, launch page or reel. They read as wireframe icons from a template, far below the hero and Live Transformation quality, and the rocket is a generic startup cliche unrelated to the studio's actual output.
findings.fix: Replace each scene with a richer CSS/SVG composition that depicts the deliverable for that customer: creator = one long timeline being cut into three vertical clips with caption bars; local business = a mini site with a services list, a date/time booking picker and a promo video tile; startup = a landing-page hero with headline bars, CTA and a launch video card; store = a product grid with image tiles, 'Request' style buttons, a cart badge and a product-video thumbnail. Use the division accents, layered cards and subtle motion; label as 'Concept demo' if they look like real UIs.

findings.title: Startup rocket flame animation is dead code and SMIL ignores reduced motion
findings.evidence: <animate attributeName="y2"> is placed inside a <path d="M150 150v35">; a path has no y2 attribute, so nothing animates (the flame is static in solutions-1440-tab2.png). Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the SVG timeline still runs (animationsPaused() false, currentTime 0.32 -> 0.82), because the global CSS rule in app/globals.css:34-36 only covers CSS animations, not SMIL.
findings.fix: Drop the SMIL element; animate with a CSS keyframe (transform/scaleY on the flame) so the existing reduced-motion rule applies, or switch the element to <line> and gate it behind a reduced-motion check.

findings.title: No transition or motion when switching customer type
findings.evidence: The panel content is swapped instantly: there is no animation class, no motion component and no CSS transition on the panel children (only 'transition' on the tab buttons). The section also has no scroll-in reveal. The spec's quality bar asks for varied professional motion (mask reveals, kinetic type) and for selection to 'meaningfully change' the visuals; here only a small icon and text snap.
findings.fix: Animate the swap with the already-installed motion library: mask or slide reveal for the scene, staggered headline/chips, and tint the panel border/glow with the dominant studio accent of the selected customer so the whole stage changes, not just the icon. Respect reduced motion with a simple crossfade.

findings.title: Panel is under-filled and jumps in height between tabs
findings.evidence: Panel heights per tab: 1440 = 368/404/368/404px; 1024 = 526/526/604/502px; 360 = 646/678/744/678px, so the layout below shifts on every selection (the tab column also stretches from 86px to about 95px per button at 1440, visible comparing solutions-1440-tab0.png and tab1.png). At 1440 the scene is only 355x237 inside an 800px panel, leaving an empty band below it; at 1024 the scene shrinks to 259x173 while the tab buttons balloon to 320x126 each.
findings.fix: Give the panel a fixed min-height per breakpoint (or reserve space for the longest headline and four chips), make the scene fill the panel height (remove aspect-[3/2] on md+ and use h-full), set the tab column to items-start with a fixed tab height, and switch to the stacked layout below about 1100px instead of the 320px side column.

findings.title: Service chips look like buttons but are not interactive
findings.evidence: The chips are <li> pills with a coloured 1px border and bold text (34px tall), visually identical in language to the outlined 'Explore Services' pill directly beneath them, but they have no link or handler. The spec says no decorative controls; a visitor will try to tap 'Booking website'.
findings.fix: Either link each chip to its studio page (/create, /build, /grow, ideally with an anchor to the service) or restyle them as a plain checklist (dot + text, no pill border) so they do not read as controls.

findings.title: Explore Services is the same generic link for every customer type
findings.evidence: href is /studios for all four tabs (verified: 'Explore Services->/studios' in every state), which lands on the three-studio overview rather than the services recommended for the selected customer.
findings.fix: Point it at the primary studio for the selection (creator -> /create, local/startup/store -> /build) or keep /studios but add a hash/parameter that highlights the recommended services.

findings.title: A few lines lean towards outcome promises
