findings.evidence: 'Turn one long recording into a week of content' implies a deliverable volume that is not defined in any package, and 'Products that sell themselves.' is a results-style claim. The spec forbids invented guarantees; these are marketing phrasing rather than hard claims, so owner sign-off is enough.
findings.fix: Have the owner approve the wording or soften it, e.g. 'Turn one long recording into multiple platform-ready clips' and 'A store built to show your products well.'

ownerTodos: Approve or reword the creator blurb ('a week of content') and the store headline ('Products that sell themselves.') so they do not read as promised outcomes.

Decide which section in the run Hero / Studios / Live Transformation / Solutions becomes light: the spec requires dark and light to alternate, and today four dark sections are followed by two light ones.

Confirm the customer-type to service mapping for the contact form prefill (e.g. Local business, Startup and Online store -> BUILD; Content creator -> CREATE) or approve adding a separate 'What are you building?' field.

audit:transformation.summary: Section 3 (components/Transformation.tsx, 177 lines) is a pure CSS/DOM demo with three tabs (Video / Website / Marketing Beta), one before-after range slider in Video and Web, and pill buttons for every option. Every control was clicked at 1440 and 390 and every one produces a real state change (pause/play, reframe, 3 caption styles, desktop/mobile, 3 themes, 3 time slots, 3 objectives, placement); there is no horizontal overflow and no performance number anywhere in the marketing mode. But there is no 3D or device at all (0 canvas elements in the section), the "footage" is flat grey and gradient rectangles, the slider labels are mirrored against the picture and run in opposite directions in the two modes, and several states are visibly clipped (wide reframe, 9:16 caption, mobile site preview, the ad card at 390). Test script and 40 screenshots are in /Users/raghusai/Desktop/CLAUDE 2.0/MAKENDLESSNWEBSITE/docs/audit/tmp/ (transformation-test.mjs, transformation-results.json, transformation-<width>-*.png).
keep: All controls are real: measured DOM change for every button, tab and slider at both 1440 and 390 (transformation-results.json) - keep the state logic and the option set (Pause/Play, Reframe, Pop/Karaoke/Minimal, Desktop/Mobile, Midnight/Porcelain/Signal, time slots, Awareness/Traffic/Leads, Feed/Story).

Honest labelling in Marketing: 'SIMULATED · ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY' badge, BETA chip on the tab, the sentence 'These are not live campaigns and show no performance results.', and zero digits in the whole panel (measured digits: []). Keep the wording.
Section footer line 'Original concept demonstrations built for this site. Not client work.' and the '(sample UI)' note on the booking line.
Headline 'See the difference.' with the prism gradient word, eyebrow, and the per-division tab accent colours (aqua / violet / lilac).
The functional sample UI idea in Web mode: selectable booking slots that update 'Table reserved: 12:30 (sample UI)', and theme switching that recolours the whole mock.
The caption timeline strip that highlights the current word in sync with the preview, and the live status badge 'EDITED · 9:16 · POP' that reflects reframe and caption style.
Objective switching changes both ad copy and CTA label (Learn more / Visit site / Get in touch) - a meaningful change, not cosmetic.

No sideways scroll at 1440 or 390 (scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0 before and after all interactions); all pill buttons and tabs are 44px high; range input is 44px high and keyboard arrows work (55 -> 57); visible focus ring 2px solid cyan.

findings.title: Slider labels are mirrored against the picture, and the two modes run in opposite directions
findings.evidence: Video: label row is 'EDITED [slider] RAW' but the image shows RAW on the left and EDITED on the right (clip-path inset(0 0 0 v%)); dragging right removes the edit, and at 100 the edit is gone. Web: label row is 'WIREFRAME [slider] FINISHED' but the image shows the finished site on the LEFT and the wireframe on the RIGHT (inset(0 100-v% 0 0)); dragging right adds the finished site. So each label sits under the opposite half of the picture, and right means 'worse' in Video but 'better' in Web. Screenshots: docs/audit/1440-home-03-transformation.png, docs/audit/tmp/transformation-1440-web-default.png.
findings.fix: Use one convention in both modes, matching the hero: before on the left, after on the right, dragging right reveals more of the finished result. Video: change the edited clip to inset(0 ${100-v}% 0 0) is wrong for that layout - instead keep RAW as base, reveal EDITED from the left edge up to v%, labels 'Raw' left / 'Edited' right. Web: keep the reveal as is, but it already puts finished on the left, so labels stay 'Wireframe' / 'Finished' only if the layers are swapped so wireframe remains on the left of the handle; simplest is to name the labels by what dragging does ('Before' / 'After') and place the in-picture RAW / EDITED and WIREFRAME / FINISHED badges on the matching sides. Default both to about 60 so the finished state dominates.

findings.title: No 3D, no device, no real footage - the demo is flat CSS rectangles
findings.evidence: document.querySelectorAll('section[aria-labelledby=live-title] canvas').length = 0 at both widths. The 'raw footage' is a grey gradient with one grey rounded box (line 39-40); the 'edited reel' is a gradient panel with two radial blobs and one word; the website is a borderless div with three blank coloured tiles and a large empty lower third at 1440 (transformation-1440-web-default.png); the ad is a white card. There is no phone, laptop, browser chrome or video frame, although the spec permits real 3D here for devices / frames / timelines and asks for portfolio-grade work.
findings.fix: Keep the logic, upgrade the stage: put the reel inside a phone (reuse the Hero3D phone and the x100 Html-transform pattern, or a well-drawn CSS/SVG phone on small screens) and the site inside a browser/laptop frame with a URL bar; give the raw side something that reads as ungraded footage (flat, shaky-crop, no captions, waveform) and the edited side a graded scene with moving captions, a cut marker and a progress bar. Lazy-load the canvas, pause off-screen, provide the still fallback.

findings.title: Not one dominant immersive demo - a 1024px card under stacked pills
findings.evidence: Measured stage is 1024x420 at a 1440x900 viewport (about 71% width, 47% height) and 350x340 at 390. At 390 the three tabs wrap to three full rows (143, 214 and 227px wide pills stacked, about 150px tall) before the stage, and tablist-to-controls is 784px of an 844px viewport. Below the stage sit a slider row, a timeline row and one or two rows of pills - the controls read as a form, not as compact overlays.
findings.fix: Let the stage go wide (max-w-7xl or full-bleed, about 70vh on desktop, about 60vh on phones), overlay the compact controls on or directly under the stage as a single toolbar, and turn the three mode tabs into one segmented control that fits a single row at 360-390 (shorter labels: Video / Website / Marketing Beta).

findings.title: Wide reframe is cropped by the stage at desktop
findings.evidence: After clicking 'Reframe', the edited frame measures 881x495 inside a stage 1024x420 high, so 75px of the 16:9 frame is cut off top and bottom and its rounded corners and border disappear (docs/audit/tmp/transformation-1440-video-wide.png). The raw 16:9 placeholder on line 40 has the same overflow (visible as a full-height grey band in docs/audit/1440-home-03-transformation.png).
findings.fix: Constrain by height as well: e.g. 'aspect-video max-h-[88%] max-w-[86%] h-auto w-auto' with an explicit height, or size the stage with aspect-ratio so a 16:9 frame always fits.

findings.title: Caption word is clipped inside the 9:16 frame at desktop
findings.evidence: The vertical frame is about 208px wide and the caption is text-4xl in Syne ExtraBold; 'SCROLL' renders as 'SCROL' with the last letter cut by overflow-hidden (docs/audit/tmp/transformation-1440-video-full-edited.png). The word that names the benefit is the one that breaks.
findings.fix: Size captions relative to the frame (container query units or clamp), or reduce to text-2xl in the vertical frame; verify the longest word fits at every width.

findings.title: Mobile site preview cuts off its own content, including the booking confirmation
findings.evidence: In Mobile mode the finished mock needs 434px but the frame is 361px tall at 1440 and 292px at 390 (scrollHeight vs clientHeight). At 390 the third slot '16:00' is half cut and the tiles and the 'Table reserved: ...' line are not visible at all, so tapping a slot shows no confirmation (docs/audit/tmp/transformation-390-web-mobile.png). 'BREW & CO.' and 'Menu · Book' wrap onto two lines each. It is also just a 190px box, not a phone.
findings.fix: Lay the mobile mock out for its width (single-line header, slots in one row, smaller headline) so everything fits the frame, or make the frame taller / internally scrollable; draw it as a phone.

findings.title: Ad card overflows the stage on phones; CTA cut off and the 'Simulated' badge covers the card header
findings.evidence: Feed placement at 390: the 250px card is taller than the 340px stage, so its top is cut, the 'Learn more' button is sliced at the bottom edge, and the SIMULATED badge sits over the avatar/header (docs/audit/tmp/transformation-390-mkt-default.png). Story placement at 390: card is 157x279 with 297-313px of content; 'Sponsored' reads 'Sponsore', the headline reads 'Ideas / imposs / to igno', and the CTA is a sliver (docs/audit/tmp/transformation-390-mkt-story-leads.png). At 1440 the feed card is flush against the stage top and bottom with no breathing room (transformation-1440-mkt-default.png).
findings.fix: Give the marketing stage enough height (or scale the card to fit with max-h and a smaller square creative), move the badge outside the card's area, and size the Story variant from a width that fits its text (min 200px) with the headline scaled down.

findings.title: Tab widget is not keyboard-complete and lacks ARIA wiring
findings.evidence: Pressing ArrowRight on the selected tab leaves 'Video Editing' selected (measured). Tabs have no id, no aria-controls and no roving tabindex; the tabpanel has no id and no aria-labelledby. findings.title: Caption animation auto-plays and ignores reduced motion; keeps ticking off-screen

The spec asks for a calm reduced-motion version and for motion to pause off-screen.
findings.fix: Initialise playing to false when matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') matches, and gate the interval with an IntersectionObserver so it only runs while the stage is visible.

findings.title: RAW and EDITED badges collide on phones

findings.title: Karaoke subtitle line is left-aligned and off-centre

findings.title: Caption timeline looks like controls but is inert
findings.evidence: The five segments (IDEAS / THAT / STOP / THE / SCROLL) are styled as a row of button-like blocks but are aria-hidden divs with no handler; clicking does nothing. The spec says no decorative controls.
findings.fix: Make each segment a button that jumps the preview to that word (and pauses), or restyle it clearly as a passive timeline with a moving playhead.

findings.title: Before/after picture cannot be dragged directly
findings.evidence: Mouse drag (1440) and touch drag (390) across the stage from 57% to 20% left the slider value unchanged at 57. The divider line has no handle, and the only way to move it is the separate range input below.

findings.title: Sample booking slots are below the touch-target minimum and stay focusable while hidden
findings.evidence: The three slot buttons measure 61x30, 58x30 and 60x30px at both widths (spec: 44px minimum). findings.fix: Raise the slots to min-h-11, and set inert / tabIndex -1 on the finished layer's controls when they are clipped (or disable them below a threshold).

findings.title: Slider has no meaningful accessible value

findings.title: Weekly calendar strip is a row of grey boxes with no role

findings.fix: Give it role='list' (or a table) and make it part of the demo: tint Reel/Post/Story by type and highlight the day that matches the current placement.

missed.title: Visitor is only told that nothing gets sent after writing the whole brief

missed.title: Invalid fields have no visual error state on the field itself

verdicts.title: Looks like a generic SaaS pricing table

audit:honesty.summary: Honest-content audit of the whole site: all 13 app/component .tsx files plus data/site.ts read line by line, and the rendered text of all 10 routes (plus 404, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, favicon.ico) dumped from the running build at 1440, with hero marketing mode checked at 1440/390/360. The site is largely honest: no prices, statistics, clients, reviews, awards, team names, contact details, real logos, external links, images, AI/chatbot service or incorporation/trademark claims were found, and the contact form never claims a message was sent. The real problems are (1) unapproved process/policy promises in the How-we-work steps and FAQ, one of which contradicts the package cards, (2) a "Join the beta list" promise with no list behind it, (3) GROW demo labelling that is missing, off-wording or illegibly small in several places, (4) "Concept demo" captions missing from the Live Transformation demos, and (5) no TODO-FOR-OWNER.md exists although the spec requires it. Evidence scripts and screenshots are in /Users/raghusai/Desktop/CLAUDE 2.0/MAKENDLESSNWEBSITE/docs/audit/tmp/ (honest-dump.mjs, honest-measure.mjs, honest-*.png).
keep: No invented prices anywhere: every package CTA is 'Request Quote' (components/Packages.tsx:32) and the intro says prices are confirmed per proposal.

No statistics, client names, testimonials, reviews, awards, team member names, team size number, phone, email, address or social links anywhere in rendered text; zero external/mailto/tel links and zero img/video/audio elements on all 10 routes (honest-dump.mjs output).
No AI automation / chatbot / AI assistant service is offered anywhere; no 'Inc/LLC/Ltd/registered/TM/(R)' claims.

Contact form never fakes a send: with no email configured it says 'this message was not sent anywhere' (components/ContactForm.tsx:34-35, screenshot docs/audit/tmp/contact-1440-valid-result.png). Keep the honesty, only reword it.

GROW Beta labelling is present on: hero tab (BETA badge + aria-label 'Digital Marketing — Beta'), hero supporting line, home studio card (BETA pill + aria-label '(Beta)'), Transformation tab, Packages tab, footer 'GROW — Beta', /studios card 'GROW · BETA', /grow eyebrow 'GROW · Beta', contact select '(beta interest)', Solutions chips 'Marketing (beta)', meta description '(beta)'.
/grow disclaimer banner: 'Nothing here is a guarantee of leads, sales or return on ad spend.' (components/StudioPage.tsx:9) and Packages beta note 'No campaigns are offered yet.' (Packages.tsx:37).

Transformation marketing demo shows no numbers at all, carries 'SIMULATED · ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY' and the line 'These are not live campaigns and show no performance results.' (Transformation.tsx:134,148).

Hero demos are original CSS-drawn content: phone has 'CONCEPT DEMO', browser bar reads 'northlight-studio.example · Concept demo' (reserved .example domain), ad mock uses generic 'yourbrand' and 'Beta — illustrative demo' (HeroScreens.tsx:53,89,120).
Section footnote 'Original concept demonstrations built for this site. Not client work.' (Transformation.tsx:173).
Privacy and Terms are openly marked as placeholders rather than filled with invented legal text (app/privacy/page.tsx, app/terms/page.tsx).
FAQ delivery answer 'We don't promise timelines we haven't scoped.' and About 'We promise only what we can deliver' — no invented timelines or revision counts.
Exact spec headlines and supporting lines are used verbatim on all seven home sections; brand spelled MAKENDLESS everywhere.

findings.title: How-we-work steps and FAQ state process policies nobody approved
findings.where: data/site.ts:102-107 (process) and data/site.ts:109-116 (faqs); rendered on / and /faq

findings.title: Motion does not actually clarify progression - steps never change state, line overshoots step 04
findings.evidence: All four dots are identical static bg-[#13172b] circles; headings and copy never react. In docs/audit/tmp/processfaq-1440-line-cold-instant.png the fill stops mid-way between 03 and 04 with nothing indicating which step is 'current'. Geometry: track spans x=144..1296 but the last dot ends at x=1076, so the line continues 220px past 'Deliver' to the container edge - the journey visually ends in empty space rather than at delivery. The line is a 2px hairline, which at 1440 reads as a decorative rule (docs/audit/1440-home-06-process-faq.png). Whole section has one animated property; no kinetic type or mask reveal, versus the spec's 'varied professional motion'.
findings.fix: Keep the scroll-linked line but (1) end the track at the centre of dot 04 (right: calc(25% - 22px) or compute from the grid), (2) derive an active index from scrollYProgress (useMotionValueEvent -> thresholds 0/0.33/0.66/1) and switch each reached dot to the prism gradient / division accent with a small scale pop, dim not-yet-reached headings to ~40% opacity and bring them to full as the fill arrives, (3) thicken the fill to 3px with a leading glow dot as a playhead (echoes the hero timeline), (4) add a mask/clip reveal on the H2. Use transform scaleX rather than width for the fill.

findings.title: Progress line intermittently stuck at 0% on fresh loads (desktop)
findings.evidence: In 3 of ~19 fresh page loads at 1440 the fill stayed at 0px wide for the entire scroll through the section and even after a viewport resize: processfaq-test.mjs first load -> 'fill=0/1152' at all nine positions; processfaq-flake.mjs runs 0 and 1 -> '0@olTop540, 0@olTop405, 0@olTop90, afterResize:0', while runs 2-5 of the same script gave 437/874/1152. Later runs (processfaq-flake2.mjs, 8/8) worked, so it is intermittent and I could not isolate the cause (no page errors logged; document height was stable at 6960). It may be partly a headless cold-start artefact, but the result in those loads is a grey line that never fills - i.e. zero motion in the section.
findings.fix: Make the fill robust: drive it with scaleX from useScroll but add a fallback so it can never stay empty - e.g. also set an IntersectionObserver/whileInView that animates to full if scrollYProgress has not updated once the list is fully in view, or use CSS scroll-driven animation (animation-timeline: view()) with the JS path as fallback. Then re-run docs/audit/tmp/processfaq-flake.mjs ~20 times to confirm 0 failures.

missed.where: components/Nav.tsx:14,25 (text-lg + tracking-[0.18em], fixed 246px wide) at 320px viewport
missed.evidence: Measured at 320x640: wordmark link right edge = 266.5px, toggle button left edge = 266.5px (gap 0); at 360 the gap is 29.5px. 246px wordmark + 44px button + 40px padding = 330px > 320px. Horizontal overflow is masked only by body overflow-x:hidden. 320 is below the spec's minimum check width (360), hence minor. Screenshot: docs/audit/tmp/foundation-v-hdr-320.png.
missed.fix: Scale the wordmark on very small screens (text-base and tracking-[0.12em] below 360px, or clamp font-size) and add gap-3 + min-w-0 to the header row.

missed.title: Final CTA beam animation ignores prefers-reduced-motion
missed.evidence: The global reduced-motion rule only shortens CSS animation/transition durations; SMIL <animate> elements are not governed by CSS animation-duration, so the three pulsing beam lines keep looping indefinitely for reduced-motion users. Observed in code; the reduced-motion block has no rule targeting SVG animate and the component has no matchMedia guard.
missed.fix: Replace the SMIL animate with the existing CSS 'beam' keyframe (globals.css:29) applied via style/class on each line with animation-delay, so the global reduced-motion rule covers it.

verdicts.title: Arrow keys do nothing on the customer-type tabs
verdicts.note: Reproduced at 1440 with docs/audit/tmp/solverify-test.mjs: with focus on tab 1, ArrowDown, ArrowRight, End, Home, ArrowLeft, ArrowUp all left focus and aria-selected on 'Content creator'. No onKeyDown in components/Solutions.tsx:28-32; every tab has tabindex=null. Tab order measured: Local business, Startup, Online store, Explore Services, Start a Project. Enter and Space on a focused tab DO select it (native button), and a 2px focus outline is present, so the tabs are keyboard-operable, just not with arrows. Severity major is fair because the brief asks for arrow support and the spec says full keyboard support.

verdicts.title: Tab/panel ARIA wiring is incomplete
verdicts.note: DOM check on all four tabs at every width: id empty, aria-controls null; tabpanel id empty, aria-labelledby null, tabindex null. Matches Solutions.tsx:30 and :34. Minor is correct.

verdicts.title: Start a Project passes ?for=<customer> but the contact form ignores it
verdicts.note: Clicked the CTA with Online store selected: landed on /contact?for=store, select[name=service] value = 'other', textarea empty, and the words 'online store' appear nowhere on the page. ContactForm.tsx:6,10,44 only accepts create/build/grow/other, so creator/local/startup/store all fall through to 'Not sure yet'. The link itself works (not a dead control), so I would call it major off-spec/lost-context rather than broken-control, but the finding is accurate.

verdicts.title: Fourth consecutive dark section; breaks the dark/light alternation rule
verdicts.note: Computed backgrounds in page order: hero rgb(12,16,36); studios rgb(12,16,36); live transformation gradient rgb(12,16,36) to rgb(32,35,66); solutions rgb(12,16,36); packages rgb(246,247,252); process/FAQ rgb(246,247,252); final CTA rgb(12,16,36). Solutions.tsx:23 is bg-[#0c1024], identical to Studios. Four dark sections in a row, then two light in a row. Spec line 18 requires alternation. The seam claim (Transformation ends #202342, Solutions starts #0c1024) is consistent with the gradient values measured. So yes, the section is dark like its neighbours, which is the problem.

verdicts.title: SVG scenes are crude placeholder icons, not business-specific visuals
verdicts.note: Confirmed from code (Solutions.tsx:10-16: 6, 7, 5 and 9 primitives, svg innerHTML only 408-753 characters) and from my own screenshots docs/audit/tmp/solverify-1440-tab1.png (an empty browser outline with two grey bars, one aqua pill and a single stroke above it) and solverify-1440-tab2.png (a flat clip-art rocket). No text, no content, nothing identifying a cafe, booking, landing page or product. Far below the hero quality. Major is fair.

verdicts.title: Startup rocket flame animation is dead code and SMIL ignores reduced motion
verdicts.note: DOM on the Startup tab: <animate attributeName='y2'> sits inside <path d='M150 150v35'>; a path has no y2, so nothing moves (flame is static in solverify-1440-tab2.png). Under emulated prefers-reduced-motion the SVG clock still ran: animationsPaused()=false, currentTime 0.33 -> 0.85. Because the animation is a no-op, the reduced-motion part has no visible effect today; it only matters if the animation is fixed. Minor is correct.

verdicts.title: No transition or motion when switching customer type
verdicts.note: Queried every descendant of the tabpanel for a non-none animation-name or a non-zero transition-duration (excluding the two links): zero elements. The code has no motion import and no animation class on the panel (Solutions.tsx:34-46); only the tab buttons carry 'transition'. Content swaps instantly. The section also has no reveal. Real; major is a fair creative-director call.

verdicts.title: Panel is under-filled and jumps in height between tabs
verdicts.note: Measured panel heights per tab: 1440 = 368/404/368/404; 1024 = 526/526/604/502; 360 = 646/678/744/678 (section height changes by the same amount, so content below shifts). 390 and 768 are stable (666 and 502). Tab buttons at 1440 stretch 86 -> 95px; at 1024 they are 320x126, 320x145 on Startup and 320x120 on Online store. Scene box sizes quoted (355x237 at 1440, 259x173 at 1024) match my svg sizes 323x205 and 227x141 plus 32px padding. I would rate the 1024 state major rather than minor (see missed item).

verdicts.title: Service chips look like buttons but are not interactive
verdicts.note: Chips are <li> elements with no link or handler (Solutions.tsx:40), 34px tall, 1px accent border, bold text; visually the same outlined-pill language as the 'Explore Services' link directly below (see solverify-1440-tab1.png). Whether a visitor taps them is a judgement, but the resemblance is real. Minor is right. Note the accent colours are correct per studio: aqua rgb(34,211,238) CREATE, violet rgb(139,92,246) BUILD, lilac rgb(199,166,255) GROW.

verdicts.title: Explore Services is the same generic link for every customer type
verdicts.note: href is /studios in all four states at all five widths; clicking it loads /studios with h1 'Three worlds. Endless possibilities.'. It is a working link, so this is polish only; minor is correct.

verdicts.title: A few lines lean towards outcome promises
verdicts.note: Text confirmed in data/site.ts:96 ('Turn one long recording into a week of content') and :99 ('Products that sell themselves.') and rendered on the page. Neither is a numeric guarantee; it is marketing phrasing. Real as a minor owner-sign-off item, not a spec violation. KEEP in this section: the four customer types, headlines and blurbs genuinely change per tab; chips colour-coded by studio; GROW chips labelled '(beta)'; both CTAs resolve to real pages; no horizontal overflow at 360/390/768/1024/1440; CTA and tab touch targets are 44px or more; the 2x2 tab grid on phones; the section headline with prism text.

missed.title: Tablet-landscape (1024) layout is badly proportioned: giant tabs, tiny scene, four-line headline
missed.where: components/Solutions.tsx:27-37 (lg:grid-cols-[320px_1fr] + md:grid-cols-2); http://localhost:3456 at 1024; screenshot docs/audit/tmp/solverify-1024-tab2.png
missed.evidence: At 1024 the four tab buttons are 320x145px each (mostly empty boxes), the scene shrinks to 227x141px inside a 608x604 panel with roughly 390px of empty panel under it, and the h3 breaks into four lines ('Look / ready / before you / are.') because the text column is only about 260px wide. The chips stack one per row. The auditor measured the sizes but rated it minor and did not report the headline break; in the screenshot this is the weakest state of the section.
missed.fix: Keep the stacked layout (tabs in a 4-across or 2x2 row above the panel) until about 1200px, or narrow the tab column to about 220px with items-start and fixed tab height; let the scene span the panel height; cap the h3 with a smaller size or text-balance at this width.

missed.title: Recommended-service chips do not match the service catalogue
missed.evidence: Spec says data/site.ts is the single source of truth for services, but the chip titles are free-typed strings that match no catalogue title: 'Video editing', 'Content repurposing', 'Booking website', 'Landing page', 'Promotional content', 'Product video editing', 'Marketing (beta)'. 'Landing page' is only a bullet under T1 Business websites, so the Startup tab lists the same service twice ('Business website' + 'Landing page'). 'Booking website' is T3 'Booking systems & web apps'. A visitor who follows Explore Services will not find these names on /studios, /create or /build.
missed.fix: Reference catalogue codes in the solutions data (e.g. creator: V1, V4, V5; local: T1, T3, V3; startup: T1, V3, M-beta; store: T2, V3, M-beta) and render the catalogue title (or an approved short label stored next to the code), then link each chip to that service.

missed.title: Section headline orphans one word and splits the gradient phrase at desktop
missed.evidence: At 1440 the h2 renders 'Made for what you're' on line one and the single word 'building.' on line two, cutting the prism-gradient phrase 'you're building.' in half. At 1024 the same headline breaks cleanly as 'Made for what / you're building.' (solverify-1024-tab2.png), which is clearly the intended composition.
missed.fix: Force the break before the gradient span on md+ (block span or <br className='hidden md:block'/>) or add text-balance so the gradient phrase stays on one line.

missed.title: Phone tab grid has uneven rows because one label wraps
missed.evidence: At 390 the tabs are 171px wide: 'Content creator' wraps to two lines, making row one 74px tall and row two 56px tall (measured 171x74, 171x74, 171x56, 171x56; same at 360 with 156px width). The 2x2 grid therefore looks unbalanced. Additionally at 360 the panel height changes 646/678/744/678 per tab, so the page below jumps on every tap.
missed.fix: Use text-[15px] or tighter padding (px-4) on phones so every label fits one line, or set a uniform min-h on all four tabs; reserve panel height for the longest state.
